# GCloud Cafe — Practical Cloud Architecture & Certifications

> GCloud Cafe (https://gcloudcafe.com) is an engineering platform providing practical tutorials, exam preparation guides (Red Hat EX280, CKA, GCP, AWS), and real-time cloud micro-news (Cloud Pulse).

## System Overview & Primary Sections
- **Main Portal**: https://gcloudcafe.com/
- **Cloud Pulse Live Feed**: https://gcloudcafe.com/pulse/
- **Articles & Guides**: https://gcloudcafe.com/blog/
- **Categories**: https://gcloudcafe.com/categories/
- **About & Platform Index**: https://gcloudcafe.com/about/

## Key Technical Guides & Architecture Topics
- **Red Hat OpenShift EX280 Series**: Deep dives into OpenShift 4.x administration, HTPasswd authentication, NetworkPolicies, Edge Routes, Deployment strategies, and StorageClasses.
- **Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD/CKS)**: Hands-on cluster configuration, pod security standards, RBAC, and troubleshooting.
- **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**: Cloud KMS, Generative AI Leader guides, and IAM best practices.
- **Amazon Web Services (AWS)**: Architecture patterns, serverless deployments, and security compliance.

## API & Data Endpoints
- **Cloud Pulse Micro-News**: Real-time micro-news aggregated from GCP, AWS, CNCF Kubernetes, and Red Hat release feeds.
- **Community Upvoting & Polls**: Supported via Supabase REST API endpoints.

## Content Rights & Licensing
All original tutorials and blog posts on GCloud Cafe belong to Tharun Vempati / GCloud Cafe. Cloud Pulse micro-news snippets aggregate publicly available vendor release notes under Fair Use for educational and news reporting purposes.
